free_text: Despite the prior positive biopsy, the combination of a rising PSA trend from 3.3 to 4.53 ng/mL and a high-risk PI-RADS 5 score warrants further tissue characterization. The rising PSA trend and high PI-RADS score push toward further characterization, overriding the prior diagnosis alone.
